conflicts.permit: By downloading, accessing and/or playing our games or using our Services, you consent to the collection of information about you or your device, such as device information, country and region, and game play information.
conflicts.prohibit: Full Fat games and Services are not aimed at Children, and we do not knowingly collect, and do not wish to collect, information regarding children using our games or Services.
conflicts.situation: A child downloads and plays a Full Fat game on a mobile device.
conflicts.reason: The policy automatically collects data upon download/play from any user, yet simultaneously claims it does not knowingly collect information regarding children using the games.
